projects.title: INTA SEPA — Heat Spot Viewer
projects.description: An interactive web app to visualize, filter, and analyze wildfire hotspots in Argentina using NASA FIRMS satellite data (MODIS and VIIRS sensors).
highlights: Re-engineered a monolithic prototype into a modular ES6 architecture (dataManager, mapManager, tableManager).
GIS frontend: Leaflet.js map, Turf.js geospatial analysis, and a responsive HTML/CSS UI (layers, legends, modals).
FIRMS data: CSV parsing with PapaParse, hybrid cache (memory + localStorage), spatial indexing with Rbush, and province/department enrichment (IGN).
Daily automation for download, validation, and merging with PowerShell and Bash scripts on the SEPA server.
Deliverables: deployed viewer, operational daily automation, Development Protocol, and Usage Report.
CSV export of filtered data and datasets.
